text:
Omar (ruby-sdk): quick maintenance question — opened a tiny PR to bump Faraday from 2.1.0 to 2.2.0 to fix TLS negotiation on some older macOS runners. PR: https://github.com/redwood/ruby-sdk/pull/218
Leah (devex): nice. does the bump change any public APIs we care about?
Omar (ruby-sdk): no API changes for us, just a dependency patch. However one of the Windows CI jobs is failing with a gem native extension build error. Locally on WSL I couldn't repro. Error snippet:
```
ERROR: Failed to build gem native extension.
checking for rb_gc_mark...
*** extconf.rb failed ***
```
Marcus (eng-infra): hmm Windows native ext failures usually mean msys2 toolchain mismatch. Which job is failing?
Omar (ruby-sdk): `windows-ruby-3.2` in the GitHub Actions matrix. Full logs: https://ci.example/gh/actions/218/logs
Riley (maintainer): can you try forcing the `msys2` setup step in the job? We have a standard action we use in other repos: `ruby/setup-ruby` with `msys2: true`. If it still fails we may need to pin the devkit version.
Omar (ruby-sdk): added that to the draft branch and re-ran CI. CI Bot: GitHub Actions #218 re-run started.
Leah (devex): while you're at it, add a small release note entry — this bump might help a few users on macos and windows. Put it under `Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md.
Omar (ruby-sdk): good call. Also FYI I added a short blurb in the PR description about why we bumped — customers reported TLS handshake failures on macos-11.6 images.
Marcus (eng-infra): if CI still flakes, I can spin up a windows runner locally and try the gem build. Ping me if you want me to pair.
Omar (ruby-sdk): thanks, will do. CI Bot: GitHub Actions #218 passed (matrix all green). :white_check_mark:
Riley (maintainer): reviewed and left small nit for a spec expectation. Omar, mind fixing and I'll merge.
Omar (ruby-sdk): fixed the spec nit, pushed. CI Bot: GitHub Actions #218 final run passed.
Leah (devex): awesome — after merge please cut a patch release and bump the sampleapp Gemfile to consume it. Also add a short note on the docs site under Troubleshooting -> TLS issues.
Omar (ruby-sdk): will do. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :pray:
Marcus (eng-infra): nice work — grateful to have fewer surprises on older runners.
Omar (ruby-sdk): merging now. PR merged: https://github.com/redwood/ruby-sdk/pull/218 :shipit:
